purpose: 二维咖啡实验室主要交互页面概念图，供视觉与交互方案审核。未修改线上/本地应用。

screens.title: 配方调配
screens.interaction: 按住添加、松手停止，观察份量和配方变化。

screens.title: 双杯比较
screens.interaction: 把同一批基底分为两杯，分别调整水和牛奶。

screens.title: 摩卡壶准备
screens.interaction: 在固定剖面中加水、装粉，识别安全阀水位与不压粉的要求。

screens.title: 冲煮与收杯
screens.interaction: 调节火候、观察出液、关火收杯，完成后返回原配方。

screens.title: 爆炸结构科普
screens.interaction: 制作中随时查看六个部件的作用，收起后继续制作。

screens.title: 双杯特刊
screens.interaction: 保留真实配方，选择构图、配色与标题并导出。

implementation.primary: HTML 控件 + SVG 固定插画、液位与流动动画；避免必须由用户操作的实时 3D 刚体交互。
implementation.navigation: 今日菜单/自由发挥进入配方；双杯比较是可选分支；器具制作与结构科普保留当前配方并可返回，六张图不是强制线性关卡。
implementation.recipe: 记录实际基底、添加物与份量；配方视图是成分示意，成品视图显示混合后的液色。
implementation.apparatus: 通过受控的剖面、局部动画、自动组装和出杯演示教授操作；不保证精确物理流体模拟。
implementation.export: Canvas 2D 合成海报插画、排版与真实配方，可输出 PNG。

reviewNotes: 图片为 AI 生成概念图，不是已实现界面的截图。
实装需核对剖面中的粉篮、密封、滤网和烟囱关系，并将第 04 页烫手提示的引线移到铝壶壁而非安全阀。
图中份量、时间和液位仅用于演示；用具体壶型说明书校准操作范围，不能代替制造商要求。
口味、浓度和萃取率不可由仅有的添加份量精确推断。
混合饮品不能真实地重新分层；配方视图只作示意。
科普页是虚拟暂停教学，实物需充分冷却后才可拆开。

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: first of five cohesive desktop browser interface concept screenshots for a Chinese educational interactive HTML coffee studio called 咖啡小馆. Generate ONE full-screen page, landscape approximately 1536x1024, no device frame, no browser chrome, no multiple panels/contact sheet.

Product direction: the cup and recipe experiment are the main interactive object. Beautiful feasible TWO-DIMENSIONAL illustrated interface, not a 3D scene. All controls can be implemented with HTML/CSS and cup/stream with SVG. Original Italian mid-century commercial poster sophistication translated into a modern editorial interface: warm ivory paper #F7F1E5, espresso ink #302015, restrained burnt-orange #B55330, tiny muted navy accents. Crisp expressive dark outlines, flat restrained color, very subtle print grain; luxurious breathing room, asymmetry, strong typographic hierarchy. No yellowed nostalgia, distressed grunge, greasy faux wood, glossy photorealism, dashboard cards or giant obstructing lettering.

Screen 1: recipe experiment during ingredient addition.
Small top-left back link '← 咖啡小馆', no full-width navbar. Upper-left editorial title '这一杯，由你调。' with small tracked Italian 'PICCOLI ESPERIMENTI'. Left small taped order slip '今日来单' / '奶多一点' / '热饮 · 自由调整'. Center large elegantly drawn straight-sided transparent glass, front elevation, filled to around half capacity. In current '配方' view, show three clearly separated schematic bands: dark Moka base 40g, cream milk 80g, caramel syrup 10g; label below '配方示意'. Exactly THREE leader labels with these ingredients and quantities, small and perfectly readable, never crossing. Small flat drawn milk pitcher above-right of cup, short ivory stream ends accurately inside cup rim. Above cup '我的第一杯' and '总量 130 g'. Just below cup modest text tabs '成品' and selected '配方'. Small horizontal actions '撤销' '搅拌' '分成两杯' and dark espresso primary '保存作品 →', with ample gaps. Avoid bulky buttons.
Right airy recipe summary: '这一杯的配方', '摩卡基底 40 g', '牛奶 80 g', '糖浆 10 g'. Below a small line-art Moka icon and provenance '示例摩卡基底' / '现做一份 ↗', integrated next to the ingredient source rather than separate mode navigation. One small useful note '加奶改变配方，不会再次萃取。'
Bottom shallow ingredient tray on unframed paper with six compact illustrated selectable tiles '咖啡基底' '水' '牛奶' '奶泡' '冰' '糖浆'. Milk selected with thin rust border. Tray caption '按住添加，松手停止 · 也可输入用量'. All illustrations match same 2D line-and-color style. Small rust diagonal poster fragment confined to a corner with generous negative space. No faux pointer cursors, annotations or tutorial arrows outside actual controls. Chinese text accurate and concise. This is a review mockup, not an infographic or marketing landing page.
